rows.grounds: direct address to Śivā/the auspicious goddess

items.question: What intimate relationship of anguished devotion does the speaker express toward the goddess Śivā?
premises: The speaker identifies the goddess as dear as life.
The exclamation hāhā conveys anguished longing.
The goddess is directly addressed as beloved and auspicious Śivā.
items.inference: The speaker expresses intense personal longing and intimate devotion toward the goddess Śivā.
uncertainties: The exclamation hāhā may convey grief, longing, or astonishment depending on context.
items.plain_english: O my goddess, dear as life—alas, O beloved Śivā, dear as life!
